title: Second Marine squadmate reaches out via LinkedIn

tellings.quote: Keep the faith. there is nothing, no borders lines that they won't cross.

plain: A former Marine named Michael Herrera, who says he saw a craft about 300 feet long in the jungle of Indonesia, says that in 2024 a second man from his old Marine squad contacted him through LinkedIn. Herrera tells Michels about the text messages and emails that followed, quoting the squadmate: "Keep the faith. there is nothing, no borders lines that they won't cross." To Herrera this is a second member of the unit backing him up.
